```yaml
name: Skill Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  collect-tokens:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
      
      - name: Collect token metrics
        working-directory: src/SkillValidator
        run: dotnet run --project MetricsCollector.csproj -- --output ./token-usage.json
      
      - name: Upload token metrics as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: token-usage
          path: src/SkillValidator/token-usage.json

  generate-dashboard:
    needs: collect-tokens
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Download token metrics artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: token-usage
      
      - name: Generate dashboard data
        run: |
          powershell -File generate-token-data.ps1 -InputPath $(Get-Item -Path "token-usage\*.json").FullName -OutputPath "dashboard\data"
      
      - name: Deploy dashboard
        # This step would typically involve deploying the generated dashboard to a web server or hosting service
        run: echo "Deploy dashboard to your preferred location"

  evaluate-skill:
    needs: collect-tokens
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore
      
      - name: Run skill validation
        working-directory: src/SkillValidator
        run: dotnet run --project EvaluateCommand.csproj
      
      - name: Upload evaluation results as artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: evaluation-results
          path: src/SkillValidator/evaluation-results.json
```
